title: Text: UTF-8 string operations (length, copy, compare)
acceptance_criteria: str_len(str) returns byte length of null-terminated UTF-8 string
str_copy(dest, src, max_len) copies with bounds checking
str_compare(a, b) returns 0 if equal, non-zero otherwise
str_find(haystack, needle) returns pointer to first occurrence or NULL
utf8_codepoint_count(str) returns number of Unicode codepoints
utf8_decode(str) extracts first codepoint and advances pointer
All functions handle null input gracefully (return 0 or NULL)
Unit test verifies operations with ASCII and multi-byte UTF-8 strings
